# `toolu hook`

Run a hook entry; hooks.json calls it (internal).

Owner: `plugins/toolu`.

## `toolu hook`

```text
Run a hook entry; hooks.json calls it (internal)

Usage: toolu hook [OPTIONS] <NAME>

Arguments:
  <NAME>  The hook entry, as in the plugin's hooks/dist/<NAME>.js

Options:
      --event <EVENT>      The host event it is registered under; absent counts as enforcing
      --json               Print exactly one JSON document on stdout
      --plugin-root <DIR>  The calling plugin's root, for the version-skew check
  -q, --quiet              Drop the diagnostics of a successful run
      --host <HOST>        The host to act for, instead of the detected one [possible values: claude, codex, opencode, cursor, hermes]
      --config-dir <DIR>   Read the toolu config from DIR instead of the host's default
  -h, --help               Print help
```
